content: सीमा .²1 Boundary, limit, border, margin, frontier. .²2 A mound or ridge serving to mark the boundary of a field, village <ab>&c.</ab>; सीमां प्रति समुत्पन्ने विवादे <ls>Ms. 8. 245</ls>; <ls>Y. 2. 152</ls>. .²3 A mark, land-mark. .²4 A bank, shore, coast. .²5 The horizon. .²6 A suture (as of a skull). .²7 The bounds of morality or decorum, limits of propriety. .²8 The highest or utmost limit, highest point, climax; सीमेव पद्मासनकौशलस्य <ls>Bk. 1. 6</ls>. .²9 A field. .²10 The nape of the neck. .²11 The scrotum. .²12 An ornament of the hair; <ls>L. D. B.</ls>
